prompt: Glossy anime game key art built around a holographic game interface: crisp clean lineart, acid-green neon light with hot-magenta glitch accents, translucent glowing green interface windows with thin bright borders, stat bars, skill icons and hexagon grids floating in the air, faint scanlines and magenta-and-green chromatic-aberration glitch at the edges, green screen light reflecting on the face and hair. A deep green-black backdrop with a dim city or dungeon far behind. Sharp, techy, high contrast; acid green is the dominant colour, not blue. Hae-won, an S-rank guild healer: a sharp-featured woman in her late twenties with a mature face and a full adult figure, black hair cut blunt at the jaw, sharp dark eyes under straight brows, a glowing acid-green earpiece. She wears a white-and-gold guild medic coat worn open with the guild crest on the shoulder and the left sleeve torn off at the shoulder, baring that arm, over a fitted black field top with the collar open at her bare collarbone, black field trousers and a belt with a cracked tablet clipped at her hip; streaks of grey ash on the white coat, green screen light on her glossy hair. Waist-up in the lower part of the picture, three-quarter view, looking at the viewer with a sly smirk, one hand raised and touching a small floating interface panel. Her smirk is dry and clinical, as if she has already done the arithmetic. Background: deep green-black space filled with translucent interface windows, stat bars, hexagon grids and skill icons; far behind her, a vast dim stone dungeon hall with tall columns and drifting pale grey ash, and at the top of a long ramp the dungeon gate, sealed by a glowing translucent membrane of hot magenta-red light that throws the magenta glitch rim onto her hair and shoulders. Colour palette: green-black, acid green, hot magenta and white; acid green dominates, not blue or cyan. Across the top third of the picture, one large holographic SYSTEM window with a glowing acid-green border; inside it the title "Cleanup Crew, E-Rank" in big bold white futuristic game-logo capitals with an acid-green glow, spelled exactly "Cleanup Crew, E-Rank". The small interface panels show only bars and icons, no other readable words. The title sits on two lines, "CLEANUP CREW," on top and "E-RANK" below it a little larger, the comma and the hyphen clearly drawn, clean evenly spaced letters, perfectly legible, centred in the window.
